meta.creativeDirection: A brand price card set in the brand's own typefaces rather than a bundled one: a display face for the headline, a script for the sign-off. Review: every line is drawn in its declared face, none in the Rubik fallback.

inputs.name: offer
inputs.html:
This week only

Fresh bread, 1,20 €

Your neighbourhood bakery
inputs.css: .card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; padding: 32px 40px; border-radius: 28px; background: #fca311; color: #14213d } .kicker { font: 24px "Brand Display"; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 2px } h2 { margin: 0; font: 64px "Brand Display" } .sign { margin: 0; font: 40px "Brand Script" }
